capabilities: read notes aloud with word and sentence highlighting
connect Obsidian to the Univocal app over a local Unix socket
control playback (pause, resume, skip, speed, voice) from Univocal's pill or panel
answer Univocal's global read hotkey while Obsidian is focused
show connection and authorization status in the status bar
extras: Public beta, macOS desktop only; the plugin itself is free but continued use of the Univocal app after its trial requires payment.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have notes read aloud with synchronized word-level highlighting while you follow along in reading view or Live Preview.

relations.evidence: Read notes aloud with Univocal and highlight each word as it's spoken, in reading view and in Live Preview or source mode.

requires.name: Univocal paid licence after its trial

summary: Text-to-speech reader that reads notes aloud through the Univocal app and highlights each spoken word and sentence in the editor.
